description:
Morning recording walking outside the market in Cayenne, French Guiana.
A moving recording through the market surroundings, with a general crowd murmur, quiet voices from vendors and passers-by speaking different languages.

Recorder MixPre6 II
ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen
Original Recording in Wave, 96kHz, 24bit
GPS 4.936232, -52.334879
REF: GUY-260124-01
Date: 24 January 2026

Recorded during a residency at Guyane Art Factory, Cayenne, French Guiana, in January 2026.
name: Walking Through Cayenne Market - Saturday Morning, French Guiana
